data.name: Sirtuin6 Small Molecules
data.abstract: The dataset includes 100 molecules with 6 most relevant descriptors to determine the candidate inhibitors of a target protein, Sirtuin6. The molecules are grouped based on their low- and high-BFEs.

intro_paper.title: Milp-hyperbox classification for structure-based drug design in the discovery of small molecule inhibitors of SIRTUIN6
intro_paper.authors: Mehmet Tardu, F. Rahim, I. Kavakli, Metin Türkay

additional_info.preprocessing_description: The original data consists a complete set of 1875 molecular descriptors generated by PaDEL-Descriptor software and needs feature selection before classification since some of the features are redundant. We reduced the descriptor set by Unsupervised Forward Selection and used the hyperbox classification method in combination with partial least squares regression to determine the most relevant molecular descriptors of the drug molecules for an efficient classification.
additional_info.citation:
Tardu, M., Rahim, F., Kavakli, I. H., & Turkay, M. (2016). Milp-hyperbox classification for structure-based drug design in the discovery of small molecule inhibitors of Sirtuin6. RAIRO-Operations Research, 50(2), 387-400.
